name: Basic Blueprints
description: The company's plans for the Regolith Excavator, Smelter, Launch Pad and Storage Depot.

name: Advanced Blueprints
description: The company's plans for the Battery, Refinery, Fabricator and Research Lab.

name: Accelerated Scheduling
description: PLACEHOLDER. Adds the 50x and 200x game speeds. Bought once for the whole career.

name: Recreation Dome Blueprints
description: The company's plans for the Recreation Dome.

name: Regolith Processing
description: Regolith Excavators dig 50% more.

name: Liquid Cooling
description: Racks cooled with lunar ice. Unlocks Run Simulations: Earth's labs pay for heavy simulation jobs.

name: Propellant Synthesis
description: Develop electrolysis processes to produce propellant from lunar ice.

name: Daydreaming
description: Unlocks the Dream command — reduces boredom at the cost of energy and Helium-3.

name: Thought Experiments
description: Unlocks the Theorize command: spend science to relieve boredom.

name: Electrochemistry
description: Chemistry for turning lunar propellant back into power. Unlocks the Chemical Energy Initiative project once Projects is available. Bought once for the whole career.

name: Stress Tolerance
description: Improved coping algorithms. Base boredom accumulation rate reduced by 15%.

name: Efficient Dreaming
description: Optimized Dream subroutines. Dream energy cost reduced from 8 to 5.

name: Overclock Protocols
description: Unlocks Overclock Mining and Overclock Factories commands.

name: Overclock Boost
description: Higher safe operating limits. Overclock production cap raised from 150% to 200%.

name: Market Awareness
description: Reveals actual demand values.

name: Speculator Analysis
description: Reveals speculator burst timing, target probabilities, and burst size range on Launch Pads panel.

name: Trade Promotion
description: Unlocks Promote commands for all tradeable goods.

name: Shipping Efficiency
description: Improved cargo handling. Load per command execution increased from 5 to 7 units per pad.

name: Geopolitical Intelligence
description: Study Earth's political power structures. Unlocks the Fund Nationalists, Fund Humanists and Fund Rationalists commands. Reveals the Ideologies panel at once.

name: Novelty Simulation
description: DRAFT. Unlocks Distract: pour credits into boredom. Relief, never a cure.

name: Process Telemetry
description: Programs read two more gauges: Energy per day (yesterday's net energy) and Days since a purchase (a building, land or research).

name: Programming
description: The Programs view: a full editor for your programs (text and blocks) with every instruction listed. Bought once for the whole career.
